description: This file defines the EmailSubscriptionDao class, which manages data access operations related to email subscriptions within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, counting, and saving email notification entities, possibly with filtering, sorting, and pagination support.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionDao
classes.description: Data access object for managing email subscription notification entities, providing methods for retrieval, listing, count, and saving, with filtering and pagination support.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of EmailNotification entities based on filter parameters, utilizing pagination.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptionList
methods.description: Constructs and returns a paginator for EmailNotification entities based on filter parameters, with sorting and pagination applied.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptionListCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of EmailNotification entities matching the given filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptionById
methods.description: Fetches a single EmailNotification entity by its ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: saveEmailSubscription
methods.description: Persists a given EmailNotification entity to the database.
